description: Land Title Settlement Department - Delgamuwa, Kuruwita D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 520801 and others
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration, specifically the declaration of a determination regarding the title to a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 23, Block 03) under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed particulars of the land, including its location, extent, and the registered owner. This falls squarely within the definition of a Land Gazette, which deals with land registrations, property ownership, and land titles.
